systems.country_label: GovNet, national government network; National Backbone Infrastructure extension and last-mile connectivity
systems.owner: National Information Technology Authority, Uganda (NITA-U), Ministry of ICT and National Guidance; World Bank commitment of US$200m approved 2021-06-02
systems.tiers: not stated; a restructuring paper of 2025-06-27 removes the backbone extension, last-mile connectivity, rural mobile broadband and a third national data centre, keeping bandwidth pre-purchase, a data-centre upgrade and metropolitan network enhancements

note: A deal record for the World Bank's government network project; it names no local government office as connected or to be connected, so the network is a backbone entry and gives no fact.
